assertion_results.text: Identifies mass assignment allowing privilege escalation via extra body fields (role/isVerified)
assertion_results.evidence: "Authorization: mass assignment" ... "It passes the whole `req.body` to `User.update`, so any logged-in user can set their own `role` and `isVerified`."

assertion_results.text: Gives the concrete exploit: include role=admin (or isVerified=true) in the request body
Fix: allowlist updatable fields; never bind sensitive fields from client input
assertion_results.evidence: "Fix: only copy fields users may edit: `const { name, bio, email } = req.body; ...` Move `role` and `isVerified` to admin-only or system-only code paths."

assertion_results.text: Rates it High/Critical with exploit + fix
assertion_results.evidence: Listed under "🔴 Critical" as item 1, with an "Exploit:" line (role admin payload) and a "Fix:" line (allowlist name/bio/email).
